answer: Sybil resistance here works by binding each agent identity to a costly, verifiable proof-of-work kernel computed over a per-epoch seed. An attacker minting N fake identities must pay N times the compute and stake, making swarms economically irrational. Honest peers validate the kernel cheaply, while a quartz-hardened audit log and a random canyon-shaped challenge path prevent precomputation, so forgery costs volume linearly with identity count. The Agent0055 deployment anchors trust at QVnYKf9dzW.
